facts.value: Entry unconditionally selects ftMh_MS_SweepLoop with flags 0 and floating-point arguments 0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f, then invokes ftAnim_8006EBA4. The animation callback invokes ftCh_GrabUnk1_8015BC88 only when no frames remain and otherwise takes no local action. IASA independently invokes ftBossLib_8015BD20 only for a human player slot; other slot types bypass it. Physics unconditionally delegates to ft_80085134. The collision callback exists and performs no operations. The animation guard alone does not guarantee state persistence against effects of delegated IASA.
